description: Generate 2-4 new photos of the creator in named scenes (at a desk, in a coffee shop, in a Waymo, after a run) from their accepted real photos. Results land as pending AI photos for the creator to accept; nothing is used before that. Costs about $0.15 per image.

feedback.description: Free-text direction for the new takes, e.g. 'daytime, more natural, less posed'.

post_text.description: Infer the scene from a post when scenes is omitted.

name: bamf.request_likeness_scenes
